prompt: What is the Maven local repository?
choices: The src/main directory of your project
A local cache (~/.m2/repository) where downloaded dependencies are stored
The GitHub repository where Maven plugins are hosted
A directory inside target/ where JARs are staged
explanation: When Maven downloads a dependency, it caches it in ~/.m2/repository. Subsequent builds use the cached version without re-downloading. You can force re-download with: mvn dependency:resolve -U
